notes: Distribution of Suicides According to Age :

The statistics of suicides by age revealed that the maximum suicides (17,626) were committed by persons belonging to the age group 18-30 years (43·8 per cent of the total suicides reported in the country) and the minimum (5,022) were committed by the persons above 50 years of age sharing 12·5 per cent of the total suicides in the country. Total number of suicides committed by the persons between 30 to 50 years was (11,320) which registered 28·1 per cent of the total suicides while the persons below 18 years of age accounted for 15·6 per cent of the total suicides reported during 1981 registering a total number of suicides as 6,277. The age-wise distribution of suicides for all the States together and the country as a whole was almost the same during 1981 and it was almost the same for the Union Territories and the Metropolitan cities as a whole.
